key_insight: Learning which actions are valid can be integrated with optimal-policy search, rather than requiring a complete action mask upfront.
engineering_relevance: This framework targets reinforcement-learning systems where checking action feasibility is a major computational bottleneck.
method: Model unknown action validity using a linear score revealed exactly by each attempted action.
Use deterministic optimistic optimization for computationally efficient, minimax-optimal learning.
Plan exploration with a computationally efficient alternative analogous to information-directed sampling.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical minimax optimality and computational efficiency, shows suboptimality on non-degenerate instances, and studies transfer with changing invalid-action sets; no empirical benchmarks are described.
watch_item: Applicability depends on the linear MDP model and exact validity-score feedback, which may not hold in noisy real-world systems.
